ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. White pixels are primarily concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edges of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region extending from the median notch across the medial surface of both lobes. Distinct white-pigmented zones are localized at the distal tips. Right distal lobe exhibits a complex map of circular white-and-black annular patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated angle of 105 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible against the water background splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge geometry tapering to sharp distal points, with an irregular concave trajectory along the trailing edge towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered circular/annular white scars concentrated on the distal end of the right lobe; isolated circular scars present along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear marks. Left lobe shows two prominent near-parallel white lines. Right lobe shows several thinner, intersecting linear pixel disruptions in the medial and distal sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of textured, high-intensity grey/white nodules (live barnacles) visible at the extreme tips of both fluke lobes. Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'target' or 'ring' shaped pigmentation patterns localized specifically on the right lobe tip.
